claims.claim: CMC helps association in the tested pipelines but can increase false positives.
claims.context: DynUAV, common YOLOv11 detector, AdapTrack CMC toggle; detector trained100epochs input1280; variant not fixed by main text
claims.boundary: Does not isolate image warping from track management; effects vary by tracker.

claims.claim: Relative size, motion, occlusion and entry/occlusion annotation policy coexist; adjacent GT box IoU does not uniquely measure camera motion.
claims.boundary: Not a verified absolute-under16px benchmark result; oracle-detection decomposition is a proposed test.

claims.claim: More tile overlap improves reported mean AP and increases tile count and forward time.
claims.context: Tile640x640, COCO initialization, overlap0vs150px; AP averaged20detectors; Infer timing averaged18 with direct timings
claims.boundary: Infer is not total pipeline latency; does not isolate boundary recovery from duplicate-view/merge effects.

claims.claim: A pair of tracker pipelines reverses ranking between offline HOTA and s-HOTA.
claims.context: FasterRCNN ResNet50, Car, P2seconds, TrackEval combined; full-machine replicas avoid queuing; StrongSORT has CMC, ByteTrack does not add external CMC
claims.boundary: Not a ReID-only ablation, single-device FIFO result or native-rate proof.

claims.claim: Association retention ratios require absolute baseline scores, scoring horizon and motion strata; availability is quantized and at least one frame late.
claims.boundary: Frame-interval sweep with fixed predictions changes availability evaluation, not physical acquisition or detector outputs.

claims.claim: Content-weighted token aggregation preserves information differently from uniform pooling, with replacement controls; each block still produces one token.
claims.boundary: Not variable token count per region, added sensor detail, or proof that weighting rather than auxiliary mask supervision alone causes all gain.

claims.claim: Tracking and semantic memory have conditional mask-quality gains; explicit FIFO bound applies to tracking memory.
claims.context: DroneEyes, Qwen2.5-VL-3B/SAM2, router active in every row, H800 benchmark
claims.boundary: Does not establish bounded semantic-anchor storage, identity recovery or infinite-stream latency.

claims.claim: Authors report edge deployment optimization while explicitly limiting high-speed closed-loop/native-rate claims.
claims.context: Jetson AGX Orin64GB, DJI Matrice4E; deployment chain includes TensorRT/CUDA Graph/async VLM
claims.boundary: Causal referring segmentation is not all-object detection/MOT; throughput is not capture-to-output age. BF16/FP16 wording remains unresolved.

claims.claim: Native local crop/RAM provides a large conditional-mask improvement in cumulative ablation.
claims.context: Given-box segmentation, frozen SAM-Large encoders, decoder training, selected iSAID classes, class-mIoU
claims.boundary: RAM difference is7.75percentagepoints; prose says7.84%. This is not automatic mask AP or detection recall.

claims.claim: Oriented-derived prompt points and decoder refinement are evaluated with supplied boxes; predicted-box/angle errors remain an unverified transfer boundary in the main body read.
claims.boundary: Not proof robustness is absent from unread supplementary; additional oriented information and decoder capacity must be matched for attribution.

claims.claim: ReSOS uses SOPSeg teacher masks from SODA-A OBB crops, confidence-based patch rejection and manual low-quality-mask filtering; automatic-method AP benchmark is separate.
claims.boundary: Not wholly hand-drawn independent GT. Teacher selection bias is a hypothesis requiring audit of kept and rejected samples.

unresolved_source_anomalies: DroneEyes Fig6 labels and prose disagree on method counts and per-size gains; those gains were not used as settled numerical evidence.
DroneEyes BF16 engine wording versus FP16 deployment explanation requires implementation verification.
SOPSeg Table2 RAM delta versus prose; Plane86.63 Table1 versus80.63 Table2; All-IoU versus class-mIoU aggregation must not be merged.
